  - because: Backing the home side of h2h because 1 pre-registered signal fired: (1) lineup_platoon_share -- the share of the posted lineup holding the platoon advantage over the starter it faces (each side's number describes the matchup that side's own lineup faces): away 57.1%, home 85.7% (this game's own values rest on: away over 9 lineup slots; home over 9 lineup slots); a gap of 28.6 percentage points, clearing the threshold of 22.2 percentage points (rung 1 of 3, the 50th percentile of that gap over the ladder's derivation sample, 4,856 games with both sides measured, 2023-24). This mechanism's direction was frozen before any search ran at +1 (the side holding more of it is the side the mechanism favours), so the signal points to the home side. Pre-registered reason it should matter: the classic exploitation: a lineup posted one-handed against a starter it holds the platoon advantage over gets more of its plate appearances in the favourable split than the club-level season line the market prices ever reflects. This is a signal count, not a forecast: the genome publishes no calibrated probability, so p_model is null and edge_bps is null by construction. Nothing here says the market's price is mistaken, and no claim of value is attached to it -- no such claim has been earned (docs/PREREG_CALIBRATED_PROBABILITY.md).
